---
title: revealjs-html-links
format: html
filters:
  - d-morrison/revealjs-html-links
---

This extension adds a persistent **"Webpage version"** button to RevealJS
presentations that links back to the corresponding HTML notes document.

Use `quarto add d-morrison/revealjs-html-links` in your Quarto project, then
enable the filter:

```yaml
filters:
  - d-morrison/revealjs-html-links
```

See [example.qmd](example.qmd) for a minimal working example.
